  o.orderdate,
  o.customerid,
  c.customername,
  ol.orderlineid,

  ol.quantity,

  ol.taxrate,

         SELECT 1
         FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sisg
         WHERE sisg.stockgroupid = sd.stockgroupid
